webster.text: Truth; consonance of a statement, proposition or other thing to fact.

example.quote: The verity of this does not depend on my assertion, but on the lives and well-known characters of different gentlemen in different parts of the continent.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
